name: kinocut
tagline_zh: AI 想剪片又怕剪坏？Kinocut 让代理先看素材、再出计划，每一步有源可查，FFmpeg 操作带保险。
tagline_en: AI edits video without wrecking it. Kinocut plans from real footage, guards every FFmpeg step, and even renders.
desc_en: Use Kinocut for guarded video editing, source-backed planning, FFmpeg operations, media analysis, subtitles, audio workflows, Hyperframes rendering, repurposing packages, and release checkpoints through an MCP server, Python client, or CLI. Trigger when an agent needs to inspect, plan, edit, render, validate, or package local media safely.
why_zh: 同类工具只给命令，它给「源文件依据」——每个剪辑决策都回溯到素材，出错能定位到帧，不是黑箱操作。
why_en: Unlike tools that just fire commands, Kinocut ties every edit to source footage, so mistakes trace back to exact frames—no.
